name: Slider scrub preview
looks: A small floating control panel holds two or three labelled sliders. Each handle glides along its track and its percentage ticks up in turn, and right beside the panel a live preview visibly changes in sync with the value, so the parameter and its visible result read as one cause and effect.
build: Each slider's handle x and percentage text are driven off the same clock value (power2.inOut); the preview's filter stack or a crossfade between graded copies keys off that identical value so it never lags the handle. Animate one slider at a time.
sound: A soft tick per slider step and a light shimmer as the preview resolves on each stop.
prompt: Show a small control panel with a couple of labelled sliders scrubbing up in turn while a live preview beside it visibly changes in step with each one, a colour, a strength, a style, so the viewer sees the parameter cause the result. Keep one slider moving at a time.
